fields.description: Raw IssueFilter, ANDed with the structured fields above. Server-side filter on assignee (isMe or id), state (type or name), labels.some (name), project (id), plus createdAt, updatedAt, title, description, team, and/or.
Words that must each appear in the title or the description (case-insensitive)
"me" for the connected user, an email address, or a name (matches names containing it, case-insensitive)
Who created the issue: "me", an email address, or a name
Workflow state name such as "In Progress" (case-insensitive)

fields.type: triage | backlog | unstarted | started | completed | canceled | duplicate

fields.description: Short team key such as "ENG" (not the UUID, which is teamId)
Label names (case-insensitive); the issue must have all of them
Created at or after this ISO 8601 date or time, e.g. 2025-01-31
Created at or before this ISO 8601 date or time
Updated at or after this ISO 8601 date or time
Updated at or before this ISO 8601 date or time
